conditions.name: Ablaze
conditions.description: You are on fire and take damage each round until the flames are put out.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: An open wound drains you, costing Wounds each round until staunched.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: You cannot see, failing tests that rely on sight and fighting at a penalty.

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.description: Your nerve has failed; you flee or cower and cannot take aggressive actions.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: You cannot hear, failing tests that rely on sound.

conditions.name: Entangled
conditions.description: You are caught or grappled and cannot move until you break free.

conditions.name: Fatigued
conditions.description: You are tired, suffering a penalty to all tests until you rest.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: A toxin courses through you, costing Wounds each round until it passes.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: You are knocked down and must spend an action to stand.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: You are dazed and reeling, suffering a penalty and unable to act effectively.

conditions.name: Surprised
conditions.description: You were caught off guard and cannot react until the surprise passes.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: You are knocked out and helpless until you recover your senses.

criticals.name: Bruised Muscle
criticals.effect: Painful throb. −10 to tests using the struck location for 1 round.

criticals.name: Deep Cut
criticals.effect: A clean wound. Bleeding 1; a cosmetic scar remains.

criticals.name: Concussion
criticals.effect: Ringing skull. Stunned 1 and −10 to mental tests until healed.

criticals.name: Broken Nose
criticals.effect: Eyes water uncontrollably. −10 to sight-based Perception until healed.

criticals.name: Fractured Bone
criticals.effect: A grinding crack. −10 to all tests using the struck location until set.

criticals.name: Dislocated Shoulder
criticals.effect: The arm hangs useless until reset; no two-handed weapons.

criticals.name: Cracked Ribs
criticals.effect: Every breath stabs. −10 to Strength- and Agility-based tests.

criticals.name: Torn Tendon
criticals.effect: Movement halved whenever the struck location is used.

criticals.name: Smashed Knee
criticals.effect: The leg buckles. Movement halved; Prone on any hard move.

criticals.name: Mangled Hand
criticals.effect: Fingers crushed. −20 to tests needing that hand's grip.

criticals.name: Severed Finger
criticals.effect: Gone for good. −10 to fine Dexterity work until tended.

criticals.name: Severed Artery
criticals.effect: Blood sheets out. Bleeding 2 until staunched, then Bleeding 1.

criticals.name: Ruptured Organ
criticals.effect: Internal bleeding. Bleeding 1 and −10 to all tests until treated.

criticals.name: Shattered Leg
criticals.effect: The bone is splintered. Cannot run; Movement quartered until set.

criticals.name: Punctured Lung
criticals.effect: Wheezing agony. Fatigued 1 that rest cannot remove until healed.

criticals.name: Gouged Eye
criticals.effect: Sight lost on one side. −20 to ranged attacks and sight Perception.

criticals.name: Skull Fracture
criticals.effect: A caved-in crack. Unconscious now; −10 to all tests for weeks.

criticals.name: Lost Limb
criticals.effect: The struck limb is severed. Bleeding 3; the loss is permanent.

rows.name: Struck Silly
rows.effect: A ringing crack to the skull. Stunned 1.

rows.name: Cut Brow
rows.effect: Blood sheets into the eyes. Bleeding 1 and −10 to sight-based tests until staunched.

rows.name: Bruised Jaw
rows.effect: The mouth won't work right. −10 to tests that need speech, casting, or prayer.

rows.name: Broken Nose
rows.effect: Eyes stream uncontrollably. −10 to sight-based Perception until set.

rows.name: Concussion
rows.effect: The world swims. Stunned 2 and −10 to mental tests until healed.

rows.name: Ear Ruptured
rows.effect: A burst eardrum. Deafened 1 and −10 to tests relying on hearing.

rows.name: Gouged Eye
rows.effect: Sight lost on one side. −20 to ranged attacks and sight-based Perception.

rows.name: Skull Fracture
rows.effect: A caved-in crack. Unconscious now; −10 to all tests for weeks after.

rows.name: Caved Skull
rows.effect: Unconscious and dying. Bleeding 3; pass an Endurance Test each round or die.

rows.name: Decapitated
rows.effect: The head is struck clean from the shoulders. The character is slain outright.

rows.name: Numbed Arm
rows.effect: The blow deadens the limb. Drop whatever it holds; −10 with that arm for 1 round.

rows.name: Torn Muscle
rows.effect: A deep gash across the arm. Bleeding 1 and −10 to tests using it.

rows.name: Sprained Wrist
rows.effect: The joint swells and stiffens. −10 to fine Dexterity work with that hand.

rows.name: Dislocated Shoulder
rows.effect: The arm hangs useless until reset — no two-handed weapons.

rows.name: Broken Forearm
rows.effect: A grinding crack. The arm is useless and drops what it held until set.

rows.name: Mangled Hand
rows.effect: Fingers crushed to pulp. Bleeding 1 and −20 to tests needing that hand's grip.

rows.name: Shattered Elbow
rows.effect: The joint is ruined. The arm cannot bear weight or wield a weapon.

rows.name: Compound Fracture
rows.effect: Bone juts through skin. Bleeding 2; the arm is useless until surgery.

rows.name: Crushed Arm
rows.effect: The limb is pulped. Bleeding 3; likely to be lost even if you live.

rows.name: Severed Arm
rows.effect: The arm is struck off. Bleeding 4; pass an Endurance Test each round or die.

rows.name: Winded
rows.effect: The breath is driven out of you. Fatigued 1 until you recover it.

rows.name: Deep Gash
rows.effect: A long cut across the torso. Bleeding 1; a scar remains.

rows.name: Bruised Kidneys
rows.effect: A sickening blow to the flank. −10 to all tests until treated.

rows.name: Cracked Ribs
rows.effect: Every breath stabs. Bleeding 1 and −10 to Strength- and Agility-based tests.

rows.name: Winded and Reeling
rows.effect: The wind and footing both go. Stunned 1 and Prone.

rows.name: Ruptured Organ
rows.effect: Something tears inside. Bleeding 1 and −10 to all tests until treated.

rows.name: Punctured Lung
rows.effect: Wheezing agony. Fatigued 1 that rest cannot remove until healed.

rows.name: Impaled
rows.effect: The blow drives clean through. Bleeding 3 and −10 to all tests.

rows.name: Gutted
rows.effect: A mortal wound to the belly. Unconscious and Bleeding 4; Endurance each round or die.

rows.name: Heart Struck
rows.effect: The blow finds the heart. The character dies where they stand.

rows.name: Stumbling
rows.effect: The leg buckles under you. Prone; lose your next move.

rows.name: Dead Leg
rows.effect: A numbing blow to the thigh. Movement halved for 1 round and −10 with the leg.

rows.name: Torn Tendon
rows.effect: The hamstring pulls. Movement halved whenever the leg is used.

rows.name: Twisted Knee
rows.effect: The joint gives way. You cannot run; Prone on any hard move.

rows.name: Broken Shin
rows.effect: A clean crack. Bleeding 1; the leg cannot bear weight until set.

rows.name: Dislocated Hip
rows.effect: The leg turns wrong. Movement quartered until it is reset.

rows.name: Smashed Knee
rows.effect: The joint shatters. Movement quartered and Prone on most moves.

rows.name: Shattered Leg
rows.effect: The bone splinters. Bleeding 2; cannot stand unaided until healed.

rows.name: Ruined Leg
rows.effect: The limb is mangled. Bleeding 3; beyond any easy mending.

rows.name: Severed Leg
rows.effect: The leg is struck off. Bleeding 4; pass an Endurance Test each round or die.

notes.body: Sin 1 → −10 Faith. Sin 3 → harder spellcasting. Sin 5 → punitive event.
